verdict.rationale: Casium's own pages describe an attorney-of-record model. It calls itself "a licensed law firm," states that "Licensed attorneys review and sign every filing" and "Best-in-class attorneys file your visas," and assigns one dedicated attorney per account rather than a rotating queue. The evidence is entirely first-party claims and names no attorneys. Missing for 10: named attorneys with bar admissions or credentials, independent or hands-on corroboration that licensed attorneys actually prepare and sign petitions.

support.subject: As a founder, my petition is prepared and filed by licensed immigration attorneys — named lawyers or a stated attorney-of-record model on the provider's own pages, not an unsupervised form service
